create_mmd_solver: create an MMDDilatedEnt solver for a two-player zero-sum extensive-form game with dilated entropy regularization
run_mmd_iteration: run one MMD iteration by calling update_sequences to compute gradients and update sequence form policies
compute_convergence_gap: compute the saddle point gap of the regularized game to measure convergence to alpha-QRE
retrieve_behavioural_policies: retrieve behavioural form TabularPolicy objects from current or average sequence form policies
compute_dgf_divergence: compute the Bregman divergence between two MMDDilatedEnt objects over the sequence form
